results.question: How do I activate my license?
results.answer:
To activate, you have two options:

- **Paste the line:** Open the plugin, click the **FR mark** on its panel, paste that plugin's license line into the field, and reload the session. The panel should say "Accepted - reload the session to activate."
- **Use the files:** Save the `.frlicense` files from your license email into `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/` on a Mac, or `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\` on Windows. Create the folder if it's missing, then reload the session. Every license in the folder is active at once.

Each plugin has its own license, so a bundle sends one per plugin. If you can't find the email, use the "Can't find your license email?" section on the [downloads page](https://fruitlessresearch.com/downloads/).

results.question: Where do I put the .frlicense file on a Mac?
results.answer: Put the file in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`, then reload the session. Because the folder is hidden by default, open Finder, choose **Go > Go to Folder** (Cmd-Shift-G), and paste that path. If the `licenses` folder isn't there, create it. Every license in the folder is active at once, so you can drop in all the `.frlicense` files from the email together.

results.question: It says could not read that, paste the whole line
results.answer:
The panel means part of the license line was lost when you copied it.

- Copy the whole license line from the email, from start to end, with nothing added.
- Paste it into the panel again.
- If it still fails, use the `.frlicense` file from the email instead.

If you still can't get it to read, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: I pasted my license but it still says unlicensed
results.answer:
A license takes effect only when the session reloads, so close and reopen the session, or remove and re-add the plugin. If it still shows "Demo ended - not licensed":

- Check that the license line is for this plugin. Each line is labeled with the plugin it belongs to.
- Or put the `.frlicense` file in the licenses folder.

If none of that works, [write to us](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: Does my license expire? Is it a subscription?
results.answer: Your license does not expire. It is checked on your own machine, and no account or server is needed to open a session. The passages don't use the word "subscription," but they describe a one-time license that doesn't expire. The only stated way a license ends is a breach of the [terms and conditions](https://fruitlessresearch.com/legal/terms/), which in practice means distributing your license to other people.

results.question: What happens when the demo ends?
results.answer: When the 14-day demo ends, the plugin keeps loading and passing audio, but it adds a brief (about 1 second) silence roughly every 45 seconds to mark that it is unlicensed. A bar across the panel says what is happening. It never mutes a track outright, never happens in the first 30 seconds of playback, and your sessions still open. To stop the reminders, click the **FR mark** on the panel, paste your license, and reload the session.

results.question: Does Trammel run on Windows?
results.answer: Yes. Trammel is sold for macOS and Windows, and the Windows installer includes the **VST3** format. The product page also lists **AAX** for Windows, but the manual says Pro Tools on Windows is not supported yet, so check that before you buy if you need Pro Tools. The 14-day demo is the full plugin, so you can test it in your DAW first.

results.question: What formats do you support? Is there AAX?
results.answer:
**macOS:** Audio Unit, VST3 and AAX. Yes, AAX (Pro Tools) is supported on macOS.

**Windows:** The downloads page lists VST3 and AAX. The manual (version 2.0.0) says Windows is VST3 only and that the Windows AAX build still needs signing. The 1.0.0 changelog says Pro Tools on Windows is now supported. I can't tell from these passages which is current, so please confirm on the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/) before you rely on Windows AAX.

results.question: How do I get the old panel look back?
results.answer: To get the original panel back, right-click the panel background and choose **Classic** under **LOOK**. Your choice applies to all plugins in the line. The window you change changes right away, and windows open elsewhere change the next time you open them. A look doesn't change any sound or setting, and it isn't saved in your session.
